hints.title: Zombie Criteria Definition
hints.text: Filter sessions where activity count is zero or the elapsed interval reaches at least 24 hours.

hints.title: Timestamp Difference Calculation
hints.text: Compute hours elapsed between start_time and end_time using datetime diff functions.

hints.title: Deterministic Result Ordering
hints.text: Sort matching session records in ascending order of session_id.

hints.title: Reference Implementation
hints.text:
```sql
SELECT 
    session_id,
    user_id,
    start_time,
    end_time,
    activity_count
FROM Sessions
WHERE activity_count = 0
   OR TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, start_time, end_time) >= 24
ORDER BY session_id ASC;
```

complexity.notes: Table scan with timestamp duration filtering and index sort.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Row-by-row procedural cursors execute orders of magnitude slower than a single query.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Evaluates predicate directly in the WHERE clause.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Handle datetime intervals accurately and sort by session_id.

solutions.code:
SELECT 
    session_id,
    user_id,
    start_time,
    end_time,
    activity_count
FROM Sessions
WHERE activity_count = 0
   OR TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, start_time, end_time) >= 24
ORDER BY session_id ASC;

SELECT 
    session_id,
    user_id,
    start_time,
    end_time,
    activity_count
FROM Sessions
WHERE activity_count = 0
   OR EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (end_time - start_time)) >= 86400
ORDER BY session_id ASC;
